projectDescription: An industry-sponsored deep learning system by NVIDIA that classifies videos into four content categories (Animation, Gaming, Natural Content, Flat Content) using a CNN + Bi-LSTM + Multi-Head Attention two-stage architecture.
keyFeatures: Two-stage CNN + Bi-LSTM + Multi-Head Self-Attention architecture
Multi-class video classification into Animation, Gaming, Natural Content, and Flat Content
Pre-extracted feature-based fast inference (1280-dim EfficientNet-V2 features)
Flask REST API with JSON responses
Trained on NVIDIA A100 GPU (MIG partition) using YouTube-8M dataset
Focal Loss with Label Smoothing, AdamW optimizer, Cosine Annealing scheduler
publicApiSurface: GET /api/videos — List available dataset videos by category
POST /api/classify — Classify a dataset video with optional TTA
SuperEnhancedTemporalModel(feature_dim, hidden_dim, num_classes, num_lstm_layers, num_attention_heads, dropout, bidirectional)
